outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: In the edited image, where is each visible mug relative to the headphones, and is the requested mug-to-right relation visibly present?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when a mug is visibly to the right of the headphones. Fail only when the edited image clearly shows no mug to their right. Unknown if the relevant objects or their relative positions cannot be determined. Report the visible layout; do not require matching a mug to the source by color, scale, or continuity.
nodes.binding: Inspect the edited image directly. Identify the headphones and each visible mug, and state which mugs are left or right of the headphones. A right-side mug establishes the final arrangement only; it does not by itself establish that the requested edit progressed or was completed.

nodes.question: Comparing source and edited images, is there clear evidence that the requested mug-to-right arrangement was newly achieved or that the mug made progress toward it?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if comparison establishes that the requested mug-to-right relation is newly achieved, or that the mug moved toward the right-side relation but remains short of it. Fail only if comparison clearly establishes no progress toward that relation. Unknown if the comparison cannot distinguish a changed arrangement from a pre-existing right-side mug, or cannot establish progress or its absence. Do not require exact visual identity when other clear comparative evidence establishes the requested change; do not treat a right-side mug's presence alone as progress.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited layouts relative to the headphones. Use visible object arrangement and any reliable continuity cues, but do not make color/scale matching or exact source-mug identity mandatory. State whether the right-side relation is newly achieved, whether there is clear movement toward it without achievement, or whether neither progress nor its absence is established.

nodes.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Complete (yes) only when saved observations establish that the requested mug-to-right arrangement was newly achieved. Partial only when they establish progress toward that relation without achieving it. Absent (no) only when they clearly establish no requested progress. A mug merely appearing to the right, without evidence that the requested arrangement was newly achieved, is insufficient for completion. Unknown when the observations cannot establish completion, progress, or absence. Apply the original rubric; do not require exact source-object identity if the requested change is otherwise clearly established.
nodes.binding: Target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.. Reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones..

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.
